competences.description: Ancient Mimic attacks all enemies. This attack ignores all effects that resist death.
Ancient Mimic devours one enemy. Once the devoured target returns to its original position after 5 waves, Ancient Mimic devours a new enemy target. [Automatic Effect]

Mitigates HP proportionate damage it receives and gains immunity against Continuous Damage. In addition, only receives damage from the enemy's first attack and reduces the next incoming damage to 0. [Automatic Effect]
